considerations.sourcePassage: This is just to remind me to say tas instead of metastasis, which I do frequently.
considerations.reason: This is a personal remark/lecture filler by the speaker and is permitted to be omitted.

considerations.sourcePassage: And I think one of the tumors that does this quite frequently is ovarian cancer, for example.
considerations.reason: The phrase 'I think' functions as a conversational filler rather than a substantive scientific hedge regarding the established fact of ovarian cancer undergoing transcoelomic spread, so its omission is permitted.
